  rotation, so days lengthen by a tiny
  fraction of a second each century. At the
  same time, the Moon drifts about four
  centimeters farther from Earth every year.
  Ocean tides link our shorelines to the
  motion of the planets, and each high tide is
  a small, visible sign of that connection.

✻ Sautéed for 14s · done 10:15 PM

❯ Without using any tools, write a 300 word
  poem about harbors.
  ⎿  1 skill available

⏺ Harbor

  Where the land curls one arm around the sea
  and holds it the way you'd hold a sleeping
  child,
  the harbor waits, patient as a question
  no captain ever fully answers.

  At dawn the water lies like hammered pewter.
  Gulls cry over the fish-house roofs,
  and the first diesel coughs awake,
  its blue smoke drifting past the pilings
  where barnacles have kept their stubborn
  count
  of every tide since someone's grandfather
